status: prepared; no actual critic observation executed
hypothesis: Pooling learned patch scores before the sigmoid may misallocate the current trained critic force; compare a paired-token payoff at the same weights and panels before any acquisition experiment.
own_judges: Each arm uses its ACTUAL trained6400 critic loaded from that exact independently qualified checkpoint; no newly trained D or initialization substitution.
context_selection: Existing predeclared privateCPU7 two-per-subject fit selection, no score-based context selection. Seven time values, all six editing sources.
panel_selection: Reuse the actual unscaled CPU72 endpoint panel batches: select batches[index//4][:,index%4], then repack into three criticB4 groups. No draws, signs, seeds or scales change. Captured full Supra student/teacher already used their original liveB4/B8 CFG3 batches; this audit never recomputes them.

payoffs.native: Four-draw context mean of public GANLoss.g_loss on the unchanged critic.forward (linear score after token feature mean).
payoffs.tokenwise: Four-draw/token mean of public GANLoss.g_loss on the same score(features(error,condition)), preserving paired patch/draw order.

gradient_coordinates: Raw physical patch coordinates. Residual is divided by each critic.scale inside autograd; output_sigma applies only to captured normalized Gaussian panels.
direction_comparison: Per context, normalize the two ownD gradients to equal unit Euclidean norm in physical patch space. Evaluate their infinitesimal negative-direction derivatives under each unchanged common native game. No finite step, optimizer, Jacobian or quality score.
self_control: Under native ownD pooled game, its negative unit gradient has slope minus its norm. Tokenwise unit gradient cannot yield a smaller slope (Cauchy). Verify this explicitly before interpreting common-critic direction differences.
descriptive_bins: Lower half and largest ceil(0.1*256) patches by saved physical residual power. These fractions describe existing error power and game-force allocation; they never enter any objective, guard, stopping, context/artifact choice or mechanism decision.
decision: Local support requires native ownD radial derivative positive above1e-8 in all24 fixed contexts AND tokenwise-minus-native equal-norm common-game slope mean below minus1e-8 in EACH of both arms x both common Ds. Otherwise stop this proposed granularity mechanism before quality training. Passing permits only a separately frozen tiny acquisition check; it is not optimizer adoption, performance selection or proof of full-Supra cause.
budget_scope: Separate CPU wall budget from command startup through imports, binding checks, checkpoint SHA/mmap critic extraction, all observations, input rehashes, report/hash and completion writes. Root owns execution; no automatic rerun/continuation.
immutability: All source/input/checkpoint hashes before and after; all retained capture/panel tensors, loaded checkpoint critic tensors and copied critic weights/modes/flags/.grad unchanged; global CPU RNG unchanged; CUDA remains uninitialized. No optimizer, policy/controller, teacher or generator constructed. mmap reads checkpoint metadata and critic tensors only; no full native tensor traversal.
limits: Local12fit contexts only; no held-out quality or full latent/time coverage.
Both common critics share an architectural family and cannot provide independent semantic accuracy truth.
Equal-norm residual-space directions do not establish parameter-Jacobian transfer, Adam displacement behavior or acquisition speed.
Changing tokenwise payoff also changes critic training gradients; a useful frozen direction is insufficient to establish coupled D/G improvement.
The tokenwise payoff does not repair every finite-critic origin force; fixed staleD nonstationarity is not a violation of joint GAN equilibrium.
Native per-context output-pooling and native KA2 input units are correct; this is a substantive experimental game law, not an established optimizer bug.
No output-MSE/RMSE objective, error-powered gate, rate/seed/head scan, quality run or structural control change.

Only saved clean FAST residuals are evaluated. Actual ownD trained with native per-site DV12; this audit does not estimate the perturbed training-force distribution or eliminate early-time noise effects.
baseline_identity: Both common native alpha1 per-context games AND radial derivatives must match the completed captured ray records at the same fixed indices/panels: atol2e-6, rtol1e-5. Replay differences are retained. No tolerance adapts to observed data.
